tournaments.format: Group Stage|* GSL Groups|* All matches __BO3__|Playoffs|* Single-Elimination Bracket|* All matches __BO3__, Grand Final __BO5__|Eligibility|* Visa required: Russian Federation|* All team members must be able to attend LAN in Moscow and obtain required visas/passports|* Seeding based on official VRS Rankings published by Valve in July|* VRS eligibility subject to HLTV.org confirmation
notes: $40,000 CIS LAN kicking off the season ahead of the Singapore Major. The third-place match has been removed and the Bo5 Grand Final returns; new conditions have been introduced for streamers.
No VRS invites or wildcards — any team from the Global Region, as defined in Valve's official regulations, is eligible to sign up. Registration is first-come, first-served.
All stages — Group Stage (GSL groups, all Bo3) and the Single-Elimination Playoffs (Bo3, Bo5 Grand Final) — take place offline on LAN in Moscow, Russia.
Registration opens July 7 at 17:00 MSK. Only one team per organization may participate, and the organizer does not provide travel or visa assistance.

All team members must be able to attend LAN in Moscow and obtain the required visas/passports; the organizer may request proof of travel ability, and failure to provide documentation can lead to removal from the tournament.

Seeding follows the official VRS Rankings published by Valve in July. HLTV.org will determine, after formal application, which stages and matches count toward VRS — ranking status is not guaranteed until confirmed.

Teams must confirm participation by July 17 or the slot passes to the next registered team, with no refunds after that date. A sign-up is valid only once payment is completed — teams have 72 hours from receiving the payment link to finalize payment or the slot is forwarded to the next team.

The full rulebook will be shared with all participants no later than two weeks before the event. The organizer reserves the right to deny participation to any team or player with an active VAC ban or known integrity violations. Prize pool is funded by registration fees and sponsors.

tournaments.name: Stake Pulse Beat II
tournaments.format: Group Stage|* 16 teams in 4 GSL groups|* All matches are __BO3__|* Group A: September 21|* Group B: September 22|* Group C: September 23|* Group D: September 24|Playoffs|* Single-Elimination 8-team Bracket|* Culminating in a Grand Final|* Played September 25-26
notes: Second Beat of the Stake Pulse VRS Tier-2 circuit, produced by Black Molly Entertainment (BME) and Stake at the BME Studio in Stockholm.

Participation: 14 slots on a first-come, first-served basis via the Stake Pulse website; 2 slots via an Open Qualifier on FACEIT, August 20-21, 2026 (single-elimination BO1 with BO3 finals). Each qualifier winner receives a full team package free of charge, and the next team on the waiting list is invited to pay for the vacated open-registration slot.

Registration opens Friday, July 17 at 12:00 CEST. Team selection begins Monday, August 3 at 12:00 CEST: the 14 highest VRS-ranked registered teams are selected first (ties broken by earliest registration timestamp), then any remaining slots are filled first-come, first-served, with the rest placed on a waiting list. Selected teams have 24 hours to complete payment or their slot passes to the next team on the waiting list.

The $3,000 entry fee (inc. VAT) includes: hotel accommodation (3 double rooms for up to 6 people, 2-7 nights depending on results, with check-in the day before the team's first match and check-out the day after their last); private practice rooms with gaming chairs, height-adjustable desks, 5 practice PCs and 1 coach PC, available for as long as the team remains in the tournament; catered lunch and dinner daily plus hotel breakfast; coffee, tea, soft drinks, fruit and snacks; local transport between hotel and studio; and free-to-use media assets (hero shots, player photos). Not included: travel to/from Stockholm, airport/train transfers, and any visa costs (BME can provide a VISA invitation letter on request).

Roster submission is due by 7 September 2026, two weeks before the event; from that point the roster core (at least 3 players) cannot change without risking walkovers. Seeding is based solely on the official VRS update published Monday, 7 September 2026 — there are no direct VRS invites or wildcards.

Cancellation policy: more than 6 weeks before day 1 → 75% refund, team replaced from waiting list; more than 4 weeks before → 50% refund; less than 4 weeks before → no refund; less than 2 weeks before → team receives walkovers, no refund.

tournaments.name: FOX Legacy 1
tournaments.location: SAW Esports Arena, Vila Nova de Gaia, Portugal
tournaments.format: Group Stage|* Two round-robin groups, all matches __BO1__|* Win = 3 points; ties broken by head-to-head, then round difference, then rounds lost, then seed|Playoffs|* Double elimination, __BO3__|* At 16 teams the four best VRS teams start in the bracket, group winners join them, and a BO3 play-in decides the final two spots|Grand Final|* __BO3__ on the main stage on Sunday, October 4|Format scales with registered teams (8-16)|* 8 teams → 2 GSL groups (BO1 opener, BO3 rest) + single-elimination BO3 playoffs, 2 days|* 9-10 teams → 2 round-robin groups (BO1) + single-elimination BO3 playoffs, 2 days|* 11-12 teams → 2 round-robin groups (BO1) + double-elimination BO3 playoffs (top 3 advance), 3 days|* 13-14 teams → 2 round-robin groups (BO1) + double-elimination BO3 playoffs (2 VRS teams seeded), 4 days|* 15-16 teams (default) → 2 round-robin groups (BO1) + double-elimination BO3 playoffs (4 VRS seeded + BO3 play-in), 4 days
notes: FOX Legacy 1 is an international Counter-Strike 2 LAN at SAW Esports Arena in Vila Nova de Gaia — up to sixteen teams from across the world over four days, managed by Carlos "KKM" Martins and appointed staff. No SAW employees take part in tournament management, and SAW receives no special treatment if they compete.

The prize pool scales with the number of registered teams: 8-11 teams → €6,000 total (€3,000/€1,500/€1,000/€500); 12-15 teams → €9,000 total (€5,000/€2,500/€1,000/€500); 16 teams → €12,000 total (€6,000/€3,000/€2,000/€1,000). Prize money is paid to the team or its registered representative by invoice or 'recibo verde'; taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

Open to all regions under Valve's general eligibility rules. The event is eligible for the Valve Regional Standings (VRS), but VRS points are not required to participate. Only individuals over 13 years of age may register.

The team representative fills in the registration form; the first registered teams are selected and contacted to proceed with payment. The entry fee must be paid within the given deadline, after which a confirmation email is sent. Teams that miss the payment deadline are replaced by backup teams, in order of form submission.

Seeding: teams with an eligible core listed in the Valve ranking receive higher seeds than the rest, based on the VRS ranking as of 7 September. For teams without a VRS ranking, the HLTV ranking from the same date is used as secondary criteria; failing that, the average FACEIT Elo of the registered players at the end of the day on 7 September is used.

Each player brings their own peripherals (keyboard, mouse, mousepad, sound card, headset and in-ears). Noise-cancelling headphones plus in-ears are mandatory in every match; missing gear that cannot be solved within 15 minutes of the scheduled match time is a map/match loss.
Weekend plan: Day 1 (Thu Oct 1) — Group Stage. Day 2 (Fri Oct 2) — Play-in & Playoffs. Day 3 (Sat Oct 3) — Playoffs. Day 4 (Sun Oct 4) — Playoffs & Grand Final.
Sponsors & partners: Red Bull (main sponsor), Twin Esports (international betting sponsor), FOX Gaming Gear (sponsor).

tournaments.name: WINLINE CIS LAN 9
tournaments.format: Group Stage|* GSL Groups|* All matches __BO3__|Playoffs|* Single-Elimination Bracket|* All matches __BO3__, Grand Final __BO5__|Eligibility|* Visa required: Russian Federation|* All team members must be able to attend LAN in Moscow and obtain required visas/passports|* Seeding based on official VRS Rankings published by Valve in July|* VRS eligibility subject to HLTV.org confirmation
notes: $40,000 CIS LAN kicking off the season ahead of the Singapore Major. The third-place match has been removed and the Bo5 Grand Final returns; new conditions have been introduced for streamers.
No VRS invites or wildcards — any team from the Global Region, as defined in Valve's official regulations, is eligible to sign up. Registration is first-come, first-served.
All stages — Group Stage (GSL groups, all Bo3) and the Single-Elimination Playoffs (Bo3, Bo5 Grand Final) — take place offline on LAN in Moscow, Russia.
Registration opens July 7 at 17:00 MSK. Only one team per organization may participate, and the organizer does not provide travel or visa assistance.

All team members must be able to attend LAN in Moscow and obtain the required visas/passports; the organizer may request proof of travel ability, and failure to provide documentation can lead to removal from the tournament.

Seeding follows the official VRS Rankings published by Valve in July. HLTV.org will determine, after formal application, which stages and matches count toward VRS — ranking status is not guaranteed until confirmed.

Teams must confirm participation by July 17 or the slot passes to the next registered team, with no refunds after that date. A sign-up is valid only once payment is completed — teams have 72 hours from receiving the payment link to finalize payment or the slot is forwarded to the next team.

The full rulebook will be shared with all participants no later than two weeks before the event. The organizer reserves the right to deny participation to any team or player with an active VAC ban or known integrity violations. Prize pool is funded by registration fees and sponsors.

tournaments.name: TESLA CUP
tournaments.format: Group Stage|* GSL Groups|* All matches __BO3__|Playoffs|* Single-Elimination Bracket|* All matches __BO3__|Team Selection|* Tier 2 Open Sign-up tournament|* The 8 highest-ranked eligible teams on the October 2026 Global VRS Ranking that signed up are selected|* Selected teams have 24 hours to confirm participation after sign-ups close|* Unconfirmed slots pass to the next highest-ranked registered team, then to unranked registered teams first-come, first-served|Seeding|* Global VRS Ranking from October 2026
notes: Eight teams will compete on LAN at Relog Media in Belgrade, Serbia for a $50,000 prize pool and the TESLA CUP title. Every stage is played on LAN.

Tier 2 Open Sign-up tournament. Sign-ups open October 3, 2026 at 12:00 CEST and close October 15, 2026 at 23:59 CEST. Any registrations submitted before October 3 were automatically declined, and those teams must register again once sign-ups open. Sign-up cost is $2,000 per team.

Once sign-ups close, the eight highest-ranked eligible teams on the October 2026 Global VRS Ranking are selected and have 24 hours to confirm. Any slot not confirmed is offered to the next highest-ranked registered team, which then has 24 hours to confirm, until all eight slots are filled.
If no VRS-ranked registered teams remain, leftover slots go to unranked registered teams by date and time of registration (first-come, first-served), each with 24 hours to confirm.
The listed prize distribution is the full payout; no additional payments will be made to participating teams.
Signed-up teams: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QyCQPU4c-skw4mHSXA6cEjYHSfo4Li6KN9c3fDYhzrk/edit?gid=2048934903#gid=2048934903

tournaments.name: ROG Journey Winter 2026
tournaments.registrationFee: 20,000 SEK or 30,000 SEK + VAT per team (with or without accommodation & local transportation)
notes: Fourth and final edition of the 2026 ROG Journey circuit. 16 teams battle for a guaranteed $30,000 USD prize pool at the BME Production facilities in Stockholm, Sweden.
Two Team Package options available (20,000 SEK or 30,000 SEK + VAT), with or without accommodation and local transportation. Includes private practice rooms and catering.
Open registration begins October 7 at 15:00 CEST via the Registration Form on the official website and X profile (@JOURNEY_CS2).

The 16 highest VRS-ranked teams from Open Registration, based on the November 2 VRS update, are selected first and contacted on November 3. Selection then continues down the VRS ranking (#17, #18, ...); remaining teams are placed on a waiting list.
Seeding is based on the first official VRS update in November (Monday, November 2, 2026). Roster submission is requested two weeks prior to the event.
